cohort: 4249 Chinese children from the ophthalmology department at Tianjin Children's Hospital were included in the study.
finding: Parental smoking was significantly associated with an increased risk of allergic conjunctivitis (AC) in children (adjusted OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.03-1.34).
mod_finding: Significant interactions were observed for mode of delivery in relation to the prediction of allergic conjunctivitis (AC).
